payload.body: Not pursuing. Architectural decision (bri): Frick is a Rust-backed framework — end-developer BACKENDS are written in Rust (against the frick-server crate), while CLIENTS stay any-language (TS/Swift/Kotlin) over the unchanged wire. So server-side extensions (policy hooks, routes, jobs, projections) are Rust-native, not WASM/sidecar/DSL. Operations stay the same via the frick CLI abstraction. The real follow-ups are the Rust extension POINTS themselves: FR-296 (policy hooks) and FR-297 (app routes).
